name: week
title: This week in S&OP
subtitle: What needs a person, where the lines are loaded, and the plan against budget

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select issue, ref, month, detail from v_attention order by issue, ref

sections.title: Capacity under pressure
sections.sql: select resource, to_char(month,'YYYY-MM') as month, load_hours, available_hours, utilisation_pct as utilisation, note from v_capacity where utilisation_pct >= 85 or available_hours is null order by resource, month

sections.title: Plan against budget
sections.sql: select to_char(month,'YYYY-MM') as month, currency, plan_revenue, budget_revenue, gap from v_gap order by currency, month

name: balance
title: Demand and supply balance
subtitle: Projected closing stock and months of cover, by family

sections.title: Every family, every month
sections.sql: select family, to_char(month,'YYYY-MM') as month, consensus, supply, closing_stock, cover_months, target_cover, status from v_balance order by family, month

sections.title: Line load
sections.sql: select resource, to_char(month,'YYYY-MM') as month, load_hours, available_hours, utilisation_pct as utilisation from v_capacity order by resource, month

name: accuracy
title: Forecast accuracy
subtitle: Consensus made one month ahead against what shipped, last three months

sections.title: By family
sections.sql: select family, months, forecast_units, actual_units, wmape_pct as error_pct, bias_pct from v_accuracy order by abs(bias_pct) desc nulls last

sections.title: Month by month
sections.sql: select family, to_char(month,'YYYY-MM') as month, forecast_lag1 as forecast, actual from v_accuracy_detail order by family, month
